{{Quote|My work barely qualifies as a weapon. It's the most humane military technology ever invented.|Doctor Eli Tarnis|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Planet Prison''' was a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] developed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Created by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]] and weaponized by a team of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] under the leadership of Doctor [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]]&mdash;in actuality a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and the son of the notorious [[Darth Angral]]&mdash;the weapon was intended as a way to peacefully [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. When the project's prototype neared completion, Tarnis attempted to steal the device and use it on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] through an elaborate ruse with the help of the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] and [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organizations. However, Tarnis was [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|killed]] in the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] by a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]], and the device was destroyed before it could be fired. The technology would be later combined with several other weapons by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Angral into the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]-mounted [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] superweapon, which the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] used to [[Devastation of Uphrades|devastate]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uphrades]], although the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] defeated Angral aboard his [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|warship]] above [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] just before the ship was destroyed by Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]].

==Description==
{{Quote|With a single activation, the Planet Prison super-charges a world's upper atmosphere, turning it into an enormous ion cannon. Any starship entering or leaving the planet will be completely disabled. Perfect enemy containment, without casualties.|Doctor Tarnis|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The Planet Prison was designed to supercharge the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with what was essentially an [[ion pulse]], turning the entire [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] into an enormous [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]]. Any [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] that attempted to enter the atmosphere, whether they be leaving the planet or attempting to land, would be instantly disabled. The [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and systems of any vessel in the ion field would shut down, forcing the ship to crash.<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" /> However, one drawback of the weapon was that it required an immense amount of energy and [[Time/Legends|time]] to charge up to firing capacity, and it generated large amounts of heat while charging.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Tracking Down the Traitor|Coruscant}}</ref>

==History==
===Origins===
{{Quote|All I've ever wanted was to protect the Republic. I was stationed here when the Empire attacked Coruscant. Saw the Jedi Temple destroyed. All those Padawans and Masters cut down&hellip; I started these weapon projects in their honor.|Var Suthra|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:Eli_Tarnis.png|thumb|right|160px|Doctor Eli Tarnis]]
The Planet Prison project was first conceived by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]], who witnessed the devastation of the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in [[3653 BBY]] and saw the fall of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Kidnapped!">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Kidnapped!|Coruscant}}</ref> The brilliant [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]] had left the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] employ in disgust after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] ended the [[Great Galactic War]] and began a tense [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the two powers, and Suthra was left with several new technologies still in the design stage. Seeing a purpose for these technologies, Suthra started several projects to weaponize the ideas,<ref name="Architect of Annihilation" /> as a way of honoring the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the attack by ensuring that the next war ended quickly.<ref name="Kidnapped!" />

The different weapon projects eventually came to be headed by Doctor [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Eli Tarnis]], though he worked mainly on the Planet Prison.<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" /> However, Tarnis was in fact the son of [[Darth Angral]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Sith forces who had led the Sacking of Coruscant.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> A Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] himself, Tarnis was masquerading as a scientist to [[Spy/Legends|gather information]] on the weapon projects.<ref name="Rescue">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Rescue|Coruscant}}</ref> Tarnis headed a five-man design team for the Planet Prison, including a man named [[Jonkan]].<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />

===Deception and destruction===
{{Quote|The Jedi of all people should appreciate what we've created. It's a non-violent means of ending war.|Doctor Tarnis|<ref name="TOR" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the project was nearing completion, and the scientists were about to begin field testing when Tarnis hired the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate to steal the design files. Black Sun tasked a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] named [[Vistis Garn]] with the job, and Garn proposed the heist as his own idea to his main employers in the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]], a rival criminal gang. Garn and his team infiltrated a [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] [[Unidentified Republic Military warehouse|warehouse]] and [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|stole]] the files from the building's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system. They also made off with a shipment of high-tech weapons and munitions, but not before Garn was identified by the building's security system. General Suthra and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]] and [[Orgus Din]] assigned Din's [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], the task of recovering the files, and ordered Kiwiik's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] and the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] to assist the Knight.<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" />

[[File:Research_Team.png|thumb|left|250px|The five members of the design team, including Jonkan, were murdered by Tarnis after delivering the prototype.]]
The Knight and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|raided]] the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|warehouse]] to where Garn had retreated, and recovered the files and weapons.<ref name="Stolen Secrets">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Stolen Secrets|Coruscant}}</ref> However, while the Knight was in the [[Old Galactic Market]] on the mission, Tarnis arranged for his own "kidnapping" by the Black Sun, right under the noses of the SIS and the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]]. The Knight and T7-O1 intercepted the kidnappers at the [[Coruscant Spaceport|nearby spaceport]] and eliminated the Black Sun criminals with the help of Carsen and the Coruscant Security Force. Defeating the Black Sun's leader, [[Zeer (criminal)|Zeer]], the trio learned that Tarnis had been taken to [[Black Sun territory]].<ref name="Kidnapped!" />

Traveling to the gang-controlled region, the Knight and T7-O1 learned of Tarnis's true identity as a Sith Lord,<ref name="Rescue" /> and pursued the traitor to the [[Justicar territory|Justicars' Sector]] in an attempt to locate the Planet Prison device. There, the duo found the bodies of the project scientists, who had been tricked into bringing Tarnis the actual prototype. One of the scientists, Jonkan, was able to tell the Knight that the weapon needed time to charge and that it generated massive amounts of heat while doing so.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" /> Using that information, the Knight and Carsen were able to locate the Planet Prison in the ruins of the Jedi Temple, and pursued Tarnis there. Standing before [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of Tarnis's father and Angral's apprentices, the Knight [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|fought and defeated]] Tarnis and destroyed the Planet Prison device.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

===Legacy===
The Planet Prison technology would later be reused by Tarnis's [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Angral, who combined it with several other stolen superweapons to create the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] weapon. Angral installed the device on his personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']], and used the Desolator to [[Devastation of Uphrades|devastate]] the Republic [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Uphrades]]. The ionization of the planet's atmosphere worked perfectly, preventing any survivors from escaping the planet, and the crew of the Republic [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] ''[[Daybreaker]]'' intentionally allowed their ship to be disabled by the field so that they could aid the survivors.<ref name="Uphrades">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Uphrades|Uphrades}}</ref>

[[File:Planet_Prison.png|thumb|right|190px|The Planet Prison's main console]]
Having successfully tested the weapon, Angral moved his ship to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and prepared to use it in his quest for revenge against the Knight for the death of his son. Above Tython, Angral deployed micro-burst versions of the Planet Prison, temporarily ionizing the planet's atmosphere and disabling the Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] mobilized against the ''Oppressor''.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Fate of the Jedi|the ''Oppressor''}}</ref>

However, the Desolator also inherited the Planet Prison's power drawbacks, requiring the weapon to charge for extended periods of time. That weakness enabled the Knight, T7-O1, and Carsen to slip aboard the ''Oppressor'' and disable the Desolator before it could fire again. With the destruction of the ''Oppressor'' by Republic fighters, the last traces of the Planet Prison technology were finally eliminated.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Planet Prison was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It serves as the target of the Jedi Knight class storyline on Coruscant, and is the first of several superweapons that serve to further the plot of the Act I storyline. Regardless of alignment choices, the Planet Prison is destroyed by the player after Tarnis is defeated.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />
